Why Damaged Nails Need Special Care?

Every salon has its own way of treating damaged nails. Standard acrylics or manicures may worsen the issue. At Element Nail Bar, we treat weak or damaged nails with our specialized methods and prevent them from further breaking by using dry/E-file (Russian) manicures.

We use nourishing, building gels versus dangerous acrylics and regular gels to restore your nails and give you a flawless appearance. Over time, these gels develop and protect delicate nails. In addition, we focus on hygiene and safety. Every surface gets purified, and every tool is sterilized in accordance with hospital-level standards. This ensures that your nails grow in a safe, clean environment, which is crucial for maintaining damaged nails.

At Element Nail Bar, we have 25 licensed nail technicians, each with five years of combined expertise. Our staff is highly trained at addressing brittle, peeling, and thin nails. Every stage is planned with our client’s nail health in mind. Such as cuticle care, sensitive shaping, and professional gel application.

Additionally, we always make sure you are never in the wrong hands. Every client’s treatment is tailored by the experts, ensuring your nails receive proper care rather than a standard manicure.

Specialized Care for Weak and Damaged Nails

At Element Nail Bar, we provide personalized nail services, unlike other nail salons that just offer standard manicures. Our experts use friendly methods and high-quality products to stop splitting, peeling, and other damage.

We also use builder gel for fixing damaged nails. It helps strengthen your nails and provides a layer of protection over time. Also, we use strengthening gels, serums, and treatments enhanced with keratin, calcium, and vitamin E to fix and nourish severely brittle nails from the inside.

A Clean, Safe, and Relaxing Environment

Your safety is as important to us as your appearance. So that’s why we follow hospital-grade sterilization protocols, which ensure every tool and surface is completely clean. At Element Nail Bar, we maintain a fresh, odor-free environment to make your visit more comfortable and relaxing than at other salons. The atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing as soon as you enter. Our welcoming, friendly staff will make you feel relaxed, whether you want a quick nail repair or a full salon day.

Repairing Broken Nails at Element Nail Bar

You don’t like your split or broken nail to ruin your day. At Element Nail Bar, we repair broken nails using methods such as fiberglass or silk wraps. Moreover, keratin-based treatments and paraffin care help repair nails and protect them from harm.

You can receive a manicure without facing the danger of further damage while your nails are being healed. We specialize in mild, restorative manicures. You don’t need to wait much longer for your nails to grow back to achieve a stunning, glossy appearance.

Why Builder Gels Are Ideal for Damaged Nails?

Builder gels are a great option for nails that need special attention. Compared to traditional acrylic nail services, builders are more protective, flexible, and nourishing for weak nails.. They help them to stop further breaking and peeling. And also give you the length and durability you want.

Our professionals at Element Nail Bar have experience using builder gels precisely to ensure your nails stay healthy and look beautiful. If you use these gels consistently over time, they may actually strengthen and thicken your natural nails.

Experience Personalized Nail Care

At Element Nail Bar, we ensure our clients receive customized nail care. We know that not every nail is the same; that’s why we offer personalized treatment for flawless results. Your requirements are our top priority, from nail-strengthening treatments to a full nail makeover. Many clients also combine their nail restoration treatments with relaxing spa pedicure services to improve overall nail and foot health while enjoying a complete salon experience.

We use nail strengtheners, serums, or treatments with keratin, calcium, or vitamin E. At Element Nail Bar, our products and techniques help to fix and preserve nail health.
